name: Watergate Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 small cans of mandarin oranges, drained
1 large tub whipped cream or Cool Whip

steps: File:Watergate salad 2.jpg|1. Combine the crushed pineapple and juice with the pudding mix in a large mixing bowl.
File:Watergate salad 3.jpg|2. Stir in the marshmallows and mandarin oranges.
File:Watergate salad 4.jpg|3. Fold in whipped cream, and refrigerate overnight.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
